lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible on the mid-lateral flank, arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows extending posteriorly from the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, forming a characteristic checkerboard-like grid pattern across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal ridges are observed on the upper flank, marked by a high-contrast transition between light-reflecting upper surfaces and shadowed lower margins.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately eight commensal remoras is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface and the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
